outer_error_nonmasking_audit.conclusion: M1609 changes only the compactor-local public error. It contains no m216/m204/service error input and cannot mask those unchanged outer OR chains when the future filelist substitutes only this one source. Runtime fault injection remains required.

filelist_rule.why: M1609 intentionally retains the M214 module name.
filelist_rule.required: Create a new filelist. It must contain exactly one of the predecessor path or M1609 successor path, never both, and must elaborate exactly one module definition.

p1.finding: Static normalized diff proves source locality but not sampled fault latency, outer error propagation under integration, or unique elaboration in a new filelist.
p1.closure: Independent filelist/runner hammer followed by directed VCS. DC is allowed only after VCS passes the registered-fault and outer-error cases.

p2.finding: The new comment says an illegal request is latched at the accepting clock boundary, although illegal requests are deliberately not accepted.
p2.impact: Comment-only wording; executable semantics are unaffected. Future documentation should say sampling rising edge.
